title: Promote dashboard to KP authoring catalog
summary: Make the project dashboard a KP-first surface for semantic objects, transformations, visual motifs, renderers/views, samples/cards, coverage, blockers, maturity, and searchable authoring state.

sourceRefs.summary: Current dashboard data builder and search catalogue source.
Current dashboard rendering surface and agenda-style rows.
Dashboard row/card model used by work, report cards, and object gallery entries.
API/object catalogue source that should feed the authoring dashboard.
Node tests for dashboard data and render behavior.
Browser checks for dashboard search and interactive behavior.

expectedLearning: What dashboard shape best supports fast navigation across work items, report cards, semantic objects, transformations, visual motifs, and rendered samples.
How much of the catalogue should be generated from typed runtime definitions versus curated dashboard metadata.
allowedWork: Expose semantic objects, transformations, visual motifs, renderers/views, samples, maturity, status, blockers, and verification through searchable dashboard rows.
Keep the agenda-style dashboard layout: one row per entity, folded sections, search collapse, and preview-on-selection behavior.
Connect dashboard rows to source refs and Theseus nodes so future Codex runs can update project state.
disallowedWork: Do not return to card-heavy dashboard layouts.
Do not make the dashboard depend on live browser-only runtime state for static catalogue rendering.
Do not implement every object/sample before the underlying catalogue schemas are stable.
